title: Restrictions on cultivated meat
note: Laws against meat grown from animal cells rather than from an animal. Every entry below was read from reporting or legal compilations dated 2024-2026 and is listed with what the law actually does; nothing here is inferred from a proposal being discussed. Statuses: ban (in force, no end date), temporary (in force, with a stated expiry), partial (a restriction short of a general ban), proposed (a bill introduced and not passed). Round 140b of the map (2 October 2026) added US states found since this list was checked, each with its source; 'proposed' there means a bill introduced and not passed as far as found.

countries.what: Law 172/2023, in force 16 December 2023. Prohibits production and marketing of cell-cultured food, and bars meat words on plant-based products. The first national ban anywhere.
countries.caveat: Adopted before the EU scrutiny standstill period ended, which the European Commission has said makes its legal effect doubtful.

countries.what: Parliament voted to prohibit the production and marketing of cultivated meat, the second clear national ban in Europe.
countries.caveat: The European Commission published a detailed opinion opposing it as unnecessary, since no cultivated product is authorised in the EU in any case.

countries.what: A 2021 law bars cultivated meat from the canteens of schools, universities, hospitals and prisons. A wider ban was later introduced in Parliament.
countries.caveat: The wider bill has not passed.

countries.what: A prohibition modelled on Italy's was introduced in Parliament.
countries.caveat: Not passed as of this compilation.

us_states.what: SB 1084, signed May 2024. Unlawful to manufacture for sale, sell, hold or offer for sale, or distribute cultivated meat. First US state to act. A federal appeals court upheld it in March 2026.
Enacted 2024. Prohibits manufacture and sale of cell-cultured meat products, with a carve-out in the statute.
HB 1006, March 2025. Bans manufacturing, selling or distributing cultivated food products derived from animal cells. Passed unanimously.
Enacted 2025. Bans sale and manufacture of cell-cultured meat.
LB 246, 2025. First Midwestern state to prohibit sale or manufacture, paired with an executive order barring state agencies from buying it.
SB 124, 2026. A five-year prohibition on sale, manufacture and distribution, following 2025 measures on labelling and state research funding.
A two-year moratorium running to 30 June 2027, after which cultivated products sold in the state must be labelled an imitation meat product.
Enacted 2025, seventh state to ban. Sunsets 1 September 2027 unless extended. Under legal challenge.
HB 0015, the Illinois Cultivated Meat Act, would prohibit the manufacture, sale and distribution of cultivated meat. Introduced; not passed as far as found.
us_states.source: CSG Midwest, 'Cell-cultured meat remains focus of new laws and legislation across the Midwest', updated 4 May 2026

us_states.what: HB 4083 would prohibit the sale of cultivated meat. Introduced 12 February 2025; carried over into 2026.
us_states.source: CSG Midwest, 'Cell-cultured meat remains focus of new laws and legislation across the Midwest', updated 4 May 2026

us_states.what: A 2025 bill (HB 1151) to prohibit in-state production and sale of cultivated meat. Not among the states with a ban as of 2026.
us_states.source: CSG Midwest, 4 May 2026; Brooks Institute Animal Law Digest, issue 276

us_states.what: A 2025 bill to prohibit in-state production and sale of cultivated meat. Not among the states with a ban as of 2026.
us_states.source: CSG Midwest, 'Cell-cultured meat remains focus of new laws and legislation across the Midwest', updated 4 May 2026

us_states.what: AB 554 would have restricted sales of lab-grown meat unless labelled and barred schools and other state institutions from serving it. Vetoed by Governor Tony Evers.
us_states.source: CSG Midwest, 'Cell-cultured meat remains focus of new laws and legislation across the Midwest', updated 4 May 2026

us_states.what: HB 2791 (2026) would make selling cell-cultured protein for human consumption a crime (up to 18 months in prison); HB 2672 would require a label. Introduced; outcome not found.
us_states.source: Arizona Capitol Times, 'Arizona may become first state to ban lab-grown meat', 20 January 2026

us_states.what: HB 4462 (2026) would ban the manufacture and sale of cell-cultured food products; passed the House Government Organization Committee on 9 February 2026. Outcome not found.
us_states.source: West Virginia Watch (States Newsroom), 'Effort to ban lab-grown meat ... underway in WV House', 10 February 2026

us_states.what: A proposed ban was shelved in 2024 after lawmakers argued it would restrict consumers' choices.
us_states.source: Stateline, 'Lab-grown meat isn't on store shelves yet, but some states have already banned it', 2024 (Brookings Register)

us_states.what: A 2024 law bars schools from buying lab-grown meat.
us_states.source: Stateline, 'Lab-grown meat isn't on store shelves yet, but some states have already banned it', 2024 (Brookings Register)
